mapper.insert: INSERT INTO blacklist (visitor_id, name, id_card, phone, reason, status, created_by) VALUES (#{visitorId}, #{name}, #{idCard}, #{phone}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE blacklist SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM blacklist WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM blacklist WHERE status = 1
SELECT * FROM blacklist WHERE phone = #{phone} AND status = 1 LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM blacklist WHERE id_card = #{idCard} AND status = 1 LIMIT 1
